stem:
Pat and Chris were candidates for school president.

Here are the election results:

Pat 80%
Chris 20%

How likely would it be for a student asked at random to have voted for Pat?

options.label: A
options.text: It is certain that the student voted for Pat.

options.label: B
options.text: It is likely that the student voted for Pat.

options.label: C
options.text: It is unlikely that the student voted for Pat.

options.label: D
options.text: It is certain that the student did not vote for Pat.
